text: Program Description This program is taught in School of Fashion & Art Design. About School of Fashion & Art Design Established in 1980\', the School of Fashion & Art Design of Donghua University is one of the best Fashion Design Schools in China. It contains every respect of the subjects and has the best equipment. Details>> An introduction to the design 2 Color picture (2) 2 Computer design software 2.5 Basic photography 2 Design sketch (1) 2 Basic modeling (1) 2 Three-dimensional composition 2.5 sculpture 2.5 Engineering and drafting 2 Computer design software application (1) 2 Initial environmental design 3 Building interior design (1) 2.5 Chinese and foreign history of architecture and interior design 2 Landscape design (1) 2 Display design Multimedia technology 2 Layout design 2 The traditional Chinese painting 2 Manual printing and dyeing 2.5 Craft art history in the west 2 Ring art computer animation research 2 Building interior design (3) 3 Landscape design (2) 3 Environmental facilities design 2 Building structures and equipment 2 Garden design 2.5 Urban planning and design 2 Lighting design Internship and Career Development Internship : the practical stages include drawing practice, professional investigation, design practice, graduation design, etc. Students are trained to analyze and solve problems so that they can keep up with the development of society and market. Career Development : Graduates mainly work with large design institutes, construction and decoration companies, property firm, art business and exhibition agency, engaged in designing, education, research and management. Some graduates choose to start their own business. Note: Students who have an insurance should deliver an attachment or a photocopy; students who don\'t have an insurance should buy one at school, the fee is 300 RMB/ smester.
